title: The $0 AI Stack That Replaced My $500/Month Tools
full_monologue: **This free AI stack replaced my $500/month tools.** I used to pay hundreds every month for tools that barely worked. Now, I use open-source AI models, free APIs, and no-code platforms that do the job just as well. It’s all about finding the right tools that fit your workflow. I’ve saved thousands and my productivity hasn’t dropped a bit. What tools have you replaced with free alternatives?
